title: Third-moment cancellation and predictable representation in finite-state BSDE approximation
summary: We study finite-state approximations of Brownian-driven Markovian backward stochastic differential equations when the same one-step increment is used both for weak propagation and for martingale representation. For a centered isotropic state-independent increment with vanishing third moment, we prove first-order convergence of the Markov value field, its spatial gradient, and the predictable $Z$-field under suitable smoothness assumptions.
